issues.description: Problem statement for Aufgabe 07 requests a list of the names of all Gemeinden (municipalities) that have a 'Freibad' and the names of the respective Freibäder (i.e., Gemeinde.name and Schwimmbad.name). The reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql) instead returns Gemeinde.schluessel and Schwimmbad.id (identifiers). This is a clear mismatch between the requested output columns (names) and the solution's returned columns (IDs). Students comparing the solution to the task or using the solution as a model will be confused about which fields to select; automatic checks expecting names will not match the solution output.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify the solution to return the municipality and Freibad names as requested. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; This aligns the solution output with the problem description and prevents student confusion or grading mismatches.
